records.title: Time-restricted feeding improves blood glucose and insulin sensitivity in overweight patients with type 2 diabetes: a randomised controlled trial
records.outcome_note: HbA1c and body weight decreased relative to usual care control over 12 weeks.

records.title: Effect of Time-Restricted Eating on Weight Loss in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
records.comparator_note: TRE versus calorie restriction plus control arm.
records.outcome_note: HbA1c decreased in both TRE and calorie restriction relative to the control arm.

records.title: Comparing the effects of time-restricted eating on glycaemic control in people with type 2 diabetes with standard dietetic practice: A randomised controlled trial
records.comparator_note: TRE versus active dietetic guidance and standard dietetic practice.
records.outcome_note: HbA1c was reduced in both groups and TRE was non-inferior to dietitian-led guidance rather than clearly superior.

records.title: Early time-restricted carbohydrate consumption vs conventional dieting in type 2 diabetes: a randomised controlled trial
records.comparator_note: Early time-restricted carbohydrate consumption versus active Mediterranean-style conventional dieting.
records.outcome_note: The two diet arms produced comparable improvements in HbA1c, with no additional metabolic benefit versus conventional dieting.

records.title: Intermittent fasting plus early time-restricted eating versus calorie restriction and standard care in adults at risk of type 2 diabetes: a randomized controlled trial
records.population_note: Adults at risk of type 2 diabetes rather than adults with diagnosed disease.
records.comparator_note: Intervention versus calorie restriction and standard care.
records.outcome_note: Adults were enrolled because they were at elevated risk of type 2 diabetes, not because they already had diagnosed type 2 diabetes.

records.title: Randomized Controlled Feasibility Trial of Late 8-Hour Time-Restricted Eating for Adolescents With Type 2 Diabetes
records.journal: Journal of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics
records.population_note: Adolescents with type 2 diabetes, ages 13 to 21 years.
records.comparator_note: Late 8-hour TRE versus prolonged eating window control.
records.outcome_note: Exploratory feasibility outcomes with no between-group difference in glycaemic control.

records.title: Time-Restricted Eating Improves Glycemic Control in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Meta-Analysis and Systematic Review
records.population_note: Mixed type 2 diabetes or impaired fasting glucose evidence base.
records.comparator_note: Evidence synthesis rather than a direct comparator arm.
records.outcome_note: Synthesizes prior TRE trials and therefore does not qualify as a primary randomized study for the included-studies table.

records.title: A randomized feasibility trial of time-restricted eating during pregnancy in people with increased risk of gestational diabetes
records.design_note: Randomized feasibility trial with usual-care control.
records.population_note: Pregnant adults at increased risk of gestational diabetes.
records.outcome_note: Exploratory feasibility outcomes with short-term glucose measures; no in-scope adult type 2 diabetes efficacy conclusion.

records.title: Effect of Isocaloric, Time-Restricted Eating on Body Weight in Adults With Obesity
records.design_note: Randomized controlled trial with parallel groups.
records.comparator_note: Calorie restriction or control comparison in adults with obesity.
records.outcome_note: Body-weight-focused trial in obesity; glycaemic conclusions are not specific to diagnosed adult type 2 diabetes.

records.title: Time-Restricted Eating in Adults With Metabolic Syndrome
records.design_note: Randomized controlled trial in adults with metabolic syndrome.
records.comparator_note: Usual care control in a metabolic syndrome cohort.
records.outcome_note: Metabolic syndrome outcomes with exploratory glucose change; not a diagnosed adult type 2 diabetes trial.

records.title: The Effects of Time-Restricted Eating versus Standard Dietary Advice on Weight, Metabolic Health and the Consumption of Processed Food: A Pragmatic Randomised Controlled Trial in Community-Based Adults
records.design_note: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial in community-based adults.
records.population_note: Community-based adults without a disease-specific diabetes cohort.
records.outcome_note: Weight and processed-food outcomes rather than a diagnosed adult type 2 diabetes glycaemic trial.
